newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chirac to meet Russian PM briefly on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Chirac to meet Russian PM briefly on Sunday.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will meet Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin during a one-hour stopover at a Moscow airport on Sunday on his way back from China, a Russian government spokesman said on Saturday.
They were likely to discuss Russian relations with NATO in the light of the signing in Paris on May 27 of a treaty between Moscow and the Western alliance.
The spokesman said the meeting would take place around 6 p.m. (1400 GMT) at the Vnukovo-2 government airport. Chirac returns to France on Sunday after a four-day state visit to China.

A spokeswoman for President Boris Yeltsin said she had no information on whether the Kremlin leader would also meet his French counterpart. In the absence of an official announcement, it seemed unlikely that he would.

Russian and NATO negotiators announced a deal last week on a treaty laying down a new relationship, an agreement which addressed some of the security concerns raised in Russia by the alliance's plans to admit former Soviet-bloc countries in eastern Europe.
